source_text.body:
Find an in-network dentist with a browser agent
The poster used Operator to search for and find a dentist in their insurance network.
·
Feb 14, 2025
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
The poster gave Operator a plain-language prompt with the insurance name, PPO plan, city, and ZIP code: find a cheap teeth cleaning in San Francisco that takes Red Cross of Alabama healthcare. Operator used the browser and returned two named dentists with addresses and phone numbers; the poster did not share a video because logging in exposed sensitive information.
How it went
It produced two leads, but commenters who checked them found errors: one listing had the wrong address and phone number, and another commenter said the first dentist did not seem to take that insurance or accept new patients.
Worth knowing
The useful catch is that human verification was still necessary, because the thread's follow-up checks said Operator's dentist matches were inaccurate.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Find dentists accepting new patients within [distance] of [zip code] that are in network with [insurance company and plan name]. Use the insurer's official provider directory and confirm each result on the dentist's own site. Give me a list of [5] options with name, address, phone, and the hours they're open, then stop. Don't book an appointment or submit any forms without showing me first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/singularity/comments/1i8fi3l/openai_operator_finds_me_an_in_network_dentist
